errors.text: The proposed B2/L12 Ti-rich nanoscale precipitates do not reconstruct the chemically segregated C14 Laves secondary phase central to the target.
Rapid quenching is assigned to suppress the secondary phase, whereas the target uses rapid quenching during arc melting to stabilize the fcc–C14 dual-phase microstructure.

The claimed strain-induced recovery of orbital moment is not supported by the cited evidence and omits the target's Ti-sublattice antiferromagnetic coupling, spin canting, and phase-specific magnetic transitions.
